items.summary: Recommendation: approve three normal-priority, metadata-only routing repairs for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject production changes, unsupported revenue or causal claims, duplicate telemetry, spending, credential/configuration changes, schedules, and high-priority queue work. Attribution is partial and low-volume; require auditable routing artifacts and rollback of only affected metadata if validation fails.
